# WakeelCheck (وكيل تشيك · AITCHEK)

> WakeelCheck shows online stores the verbatim answer AI assistants give their
> customers — which stores ChatGPT and Google AI Mode name, whether the store is
> among them, the sources the answer relied on, the measured technical cause, and
> a ready-to-paste fix. Arabic-first (Gulf and Maghreb), also in English.

## What it measures

- **ChatGPT** — via the OpenAI API with web search on.
- **Google AI Mode** and **Google AI Overviews** — via DataForSEO, from the store's country.
- **Perplexity** — in weekly monitoring.
- Questions are written the way shoppers ask, in the store's language and country.

## What it does not measure

- Gemini inside Chrome, Apple Intelligence, and per-user personalised answers.
  These surfaces have no public interface; we say so rather than estimate them.

## The report

- The answer verbatim, with competitor names marked only when they appear literally.
- A comparison of who is named in each engine.
- Readiness checks: live-search crawler access (OAI-SearchBot, Googlebot, Bingbot,
  PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot — training crawlers reported separately), product
  structured data, price and availability consistency, sitemap, headings, image alt text.
- A passive security check from public sources only.

## Pricing

- Free scan: two buying questions on ChatGPT and Google AI Mode, full report, no signup.
- Weekly monitoring: $39/month or $390/year, first 14 days free. Payments by Lemon Squeezy.

## Principles

- The answer is shown verbatim: no cleaning, trimming or rewording.
- No number without a source. No guarantee of appearing in any answer.
